summary.name: The Real Python Podcast
summary.one_liner: A weekly Python podcast hosted by Christopher Trudeau (listed as Christopher Bailey in the meta description) with interviews, coding tips, and discussion of Python news and career topics.
use_cases: Keeping up with new Python releases and features
Hearing from Python community members and book authors
Picking up Python career and best-practice advice during commutes
Finding links to tutorials and projects mentioned in episodes
summary.what_it_does: The podcast releases a weekly episode, typically on Fridays, hosted by Christopher Trudeau. Episodes feature interviews with guests from the Python community, often authors or maintainers discussing new books, projects, or tools. Many episodes are built around PyCoder's Weekly articles and projects, and the page notes that show notes include timecodes and extra course and exploratory links. Recent episode topics on the page include Python 3.15 features, Python security, LLM coding agents, and Polars. Listeners can send questions or episode ideas by email, Twitter, or voicemail.
